# Agent Office
**Tiny coworkers. Real work.** Watch your DeepSeek Harness agents work in a living pixel office.
简体中文 · MIT · Zero runtime dependencies · No extra API key
Your agents leave their desks to use tools, queue up when they need approval, and take a breather wh
en a turn finishes. Click a coworker to inspect their activity. Everything in live mode comes from H
arness session events.

## Connect your actual agents
Requires Node **22.19+** and DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-alpha.4**. This first release deliberately dec
lares only the DSH version whose API was checked. New DSH releases need compatibility verification b
efore widening `engines.dsh`.
From a directory containing the downloaded `dsh-agent-office` folder:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
If the CLI is not globally installed, replace `dsh` with `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.4`. Confi
gure your model in the Harness profile as usual. Open **http://127.0.0.1:4319** alongside the Harnes
s UI and start a task. The office logs its URL to the terminal when loaded.
To install into an existing profile, substitute its name for `office`. A server restart is needed af
ter installation. Stop the standalone demo before enabling the plugin: both default to port 4319. Th
e first release is a separate browser dashboard, not an embedded Harness sidebar or an operating-sys
tem desktop overlay.

## What's inside
- Original procedural pixel art: focus desks, tool lab, approval corner, sofas, plants, and animated

coworkers. No downloaded assets or font services.
- Real event projection for main sessions and sub

agent sessions. Parent links represent **session lineage**, not inferred conversations.
- Independen

t pending-tool and approval tracking; parallel requests do not prematurely clear a waiting status.
-
Distinct completion, error, blocked, paused, and idle states. “Done” means a turn completed, not th

at the project passed acceptance tests.
- Clickable roster, activity feed, per-session steps/tool ca

lls/reported tokens, and PNG scene export.
- English / 简体中文, midnight / daylight themes, focus view,

mobile layout, and reduced-motion support.
- Reconnecting event stream with an explicit stale-state

indicator.
- No model calls, extra API keys, runtime dependencies, telemetry, or changes to the age

or.
- No model calls, extra API keys, runtime dependencies, telemetry, or changes to the agent loop.
## Configuration
Edit the installed bundle row through your profile overlay:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Setting     | Default | Range      | Purpose                                               |

| `port`      | 4319    | 1024–65535 | Loopback-only office server                           |
| `ma

xAgents` | 48      | 1–200      | Tracked sessions; inactive sessions are evicted first |
| `maxEven
ts` | 120     | 10–500     | In-memory activity history                            |
Up to **12 coworkers are drawn at once**; all tracked sessions remain selectable in the roster. Sele
cting another session brings it onto the floor. If the tracking cap is full of active sessions, new
sessions are ignored until a slot becomes available. Counters cover retained sessions since plugin s
tartup, not lifetime totals. UI feed shows the latest six events.
The port is fixed rather than silently changed. If occupied, the plugin logs an actionable error and
leaves Harness running. Change it in your configuration and restart.
## Data and permissions
The office observes `session/event` and `session/disposed` at the profile root. It does not register
tools, intercept execution, approve operations, or send data to a third party. Approval happens in
the original Harness conversation.
Only session IDs, parent IDs, generated names, the last folder name of the working directory, tool n
ames, lifecycle statuses, timestamps, and reported token counts enter the office projection. Prompts
, assistant text, reasoning, tool arguments/results, full paths, and approval explanations are exclu
ded. Displayed text is inserted as text, not HTML.
The HTTP server binds exclusively to `127.0.0.1`, checks Host and Origin, has no write endpoints, an
d closes on plugin unload. Any process or user with access to this machine's loopback can read the d
isplayed metadata. This version is intended for a trusted local machine, not remote hosting. Do not
expose its port publicly.
State is in memory. Existing idle conversations and pre-load history are not imported; a session app
ears on its next observed event. A restart clears the office. A detached session remains as a paused
/terminal entry until eviction. Tasks run in a different Harness process are not visible.
## Development and verification
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Eight dependency-free tests cover concurrent tools/approvals, terminal reasons, bounded history, sen
sitive-data exclusion, token accounting, HTTP/SSE, host/origin protection, port conflicts, and clean
up. Published Cordis **4.0.5-alpha.2** and DSH SessionStore **0.2.1-alpha.4** were separately used t
o check real session append → plugin → HTTP state and unload cleanup. A full model-backed DSH end-to
-end run has not yet been performed.
Browser checks cover desktop/mobile layouts, SSE updates, selection, both languages, themes, focus,
and PNG export. See verification notes.
## Share the little office
The preview GIF and screenshots in `docs/` are ready for a GitHub README or release post. They are l
abeled demonstrations. Source: xx-ytg/dsh-agent-office. This plugin has not been published to npm.
